source.citation: 'Prairie Avenue (Looking North West) (Between 20th & 18th Streets).' Street-front drawing, the right-hand strip of p. 269 in Rand, McNally & Co.'s Bird's-Eye Views and Guide to Chicago (Chicago: Rand, McNally & Co., 1893); artist not named.
